name: vibeswitch
displayName: VibeSwitch - Stay Aware, Stay in Control: Steer Your AI Speed
description: Stop working on autopilot with AI. Live awareness monitoring helps you stay conscious and intentional.

commands.title: Install Grind Script to VibeSwitch Hooks
Set Cursor Usage Token (for dashboard token count)
Test: Add AI Code with Marker

vibeswitch.showInStatusBar.description: Show the Report item in the status bar (click opens dashboard)

vibeswitch.awarenessHighScoreFrameFlash.description: When awareness (risk) score crosses the threshold, briefly flash the window outer border cyan. Windows: uses window.border (VS Code 1.104+). macOS/Linux: uses workbench.colorCustomizations with custom title bar (window.titleBarStyle: custom).

vibeswitch.awarenessHighScoreFrameFlashT.description: Risk score (0–100) at or above which the window border flash triggers (e.g. 60 = warning level).

vibeswitch.awarenessHighScoreFrameFlashD.description: How long the cyan border is shown before restoring (milliseconds).

vibeswitch.awarenessHighScoreFrameFlashC.description: Hex color for the window border flash (e.g. #00FFFF for cyan).

vibeswitch.disableLogging.description: Disable non-essential VibeSwitch logs (errors may still appear)

vibeswitch.debugLogging.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting

vibeswitch.rulesPath.description: Custom path to .cursor/rules.md files (leave empty for workspace root)

vibeswitch.autoReload.description: [DEPRECATED] Not used - mode switches are instant via .cursor/rules.md

vibeswitch.skipCursorSettings.description: [DEPRECATED] Not used - extension only modifies .cursor/rules.md, not settings

vibeswitch.enableTelemetry.description: Enable real-time awareness monitoring and long-term statistics (100% local, never sent anywhere)

vibeswitch.autoRevertUnapprovedEdits.description: In DEV mode, automatically revert file edits that weren't made through the approved MCP workflow (requires git). Currently disabled - file editing is allowed in DEV mode.

vibeswitch.recordTraceToFile.description: Dev-only: record awareness events to a trace file for replay tests. Do not enable in production.

vibeswitch.recordTracePath.description: Dev-only: path for trace file when recordTraceToFile is true. If empty, uses tests/awareness/recordings/session_<timestamp>.trace.json under extension path.

vibeswitch.llm.enabled.description: Enable LLM-based semantic insights for awareness scoring (optional, async enrichment)

vibeswitch.llm.provider.description: LLM provider. 'local' uses deterministic heuristics and sends nothing externally.

vibeswitch.llm.triggerOnAI.description: Trigger LLM insight generation for AI-labeled batches

vibeswitch.llm.triggerOnLargeBatches.description: Trigger LLM insight generation for large batches even if not AI-labeled

vibeswitch.llm.largeBatchThreshold.description: Large batch threshold (inserted+deleted characters) for triggering LLM insights

vibeswitch.llm.sendDiffBullets.description: Send diff bullets (high-level summaries) to the LLM provider

vibeswitch.llm.maxDiffBullets.description: Maximum number of diff bullets sent to the LLM provider

vibeswitch.llm.sendSnippets.description: Send small inserted-text snippets to the LLM provider (privacy-sensitive; OFF by default)

vibeswitch.llm.snippetCharLimit.description: Maximum snippet size (characters) if snippets are enabled

vibeswitch.llm.maxPerMinute.description: Max LLM insight requests per minute

vibeswitch.llm.maxPerDay.description: Max LLM insight requests per day

vibeswitch.llm.cacheTtlMs.description: Cache TTL for LLM insight results in milliseconds

vibeswitch.llm.openai.apiKey.description: OpenAI API key (only used when provider=openai). Consider using environment variables if possible.

vibeswitch.llm.openai.model.description: OpenAI model name (only used when provider=openai)

vibeswitch.dashboardChat.enabled.description: Use LLM for dashboard chat (read-only agent). If false or no API key, stub replies only.

vibeswitch.dashboardChat.useWorkspaceCon.description: Include read-only snippets from open files in dashboard chat context.

vibeswitch.dashboardChat.timeoutMs.description: Timeout for dashboard chat LLM request (ms).

vibeswitch.research.enabled.description: Enable research module: gather objective code quality data (Sonar, token usage, extension metrics) and send to external analysis agent (Fastify/Cloud Run). Analysis is performed by the external Claude agent, not in the extension.

vibeswitch.research.agentUrl.description: Base URL of the research analysis agent (e.g. https://your-service-xxx.run.app). Extension POSTs to /ingest. Leave empty to disable sending.

vibeswitch.research.pollIntervalMs.description: How often to gather and send research data to the agent (milliseconds). Default 5 min.

vibeswitch.research.daily.enabled.description: Run daily research: fetch from arxiv, Medium, LinkedIn, X (@karpathy) and write a report to researchReview/reports/YYYY-MM-DD.md once per day. Requires research.enabled.

vibeswitch.sonar.projectKey.description: SonarCloud project key (e.g. org_repo) for research/dashboard measures. Leave empty to disable.

vibeswitch.sonar.branch.description: Optional SonarCloud branch (e.g. main, dev) for branch-specific measures.

vibeswitch.eslint.enabled.description: Run ESLint on workspace for research/dashboard metrics (errors, warnings). Uses project config when present.

vibeswitch.eslint.patterns.description: Glob patterns for files to lint (e.g. **/*.js). Used when ESLint is enabled.

vibeswitch.eslint.timeoutMs.description: Max time for one ESLint run (ms). On timeout, metrics are reported unavailable.

vibeswitch.projectProgress.plan.path.description: Path to plan file relative to workspace.

vibeswitch.projectProgress.jira.enabled.description: Measure schedule deviation from Jira active sprint.

vibeswitch.projectProgress.jira.email.description: Jira email for Basic auth; token in secret.

vibeswitch.dashboardChat.includeKeyFiles.description: Include key files (package.json, README, source) in dashboard chat context via findFiles.

vibeswitch.dashboardChat.openai.apiKey.description: OpenAI API key for dashboard chat. If empty, uses vibeswitch.llm.openai.apiKey.

vibeswitch.dashboardChat.openai.model.description: OpenAI model for dashboard chat. If empty, uses vibeswitch.llm.openai.model.

vibeswitch.agents.enabled.description: Enable multi-agent architecture (QA, Security, Architecture agents)

vibeswitch.agents.gatewayUrl.description: Cloud Run agent gateway URL (e.g., https://agent-gateway-xxx.run.app)

vibeswitch.agents.authToken.description: Authentication token for agent gateway (or leave empty to use keypair-based auth)

vibeswitch.agents.triggerOnSave.description: Trigger agents on file save (debounced, DEV mode only or high risk)

vibeswitch.agents.triggerOnCommit.description: Trigger agents before commit (best signal/noise ratio)

scripts.build:dashboard: cd dashboard-app && npm install && npm run build
